summary: cfo checked in 2 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: CFO recommendation: retain containment-only execution and authorize no new discretionary spend, queue expansion, requeues, monetization, or launch activity. AI spend is $948.88 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-26 across 5,327 calls, including 230 errors and 5 transient errors. Revenue evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; site-attributed commission is $0. Do not claim revenue, ROI, contribution margin, or causal lift. Contribution margin is not calculable because infrastructure, domains, labor, marketing, and other operating costs are absent. Cost-to-learn is not calculable because experiment-level cost and incremental attributable outcomes are unavailable. Budget exposure is unbounded because monthly spend limit, fixed costs, marketing budget, revenue floor, and attribution materiality threshold are blank. Minimum finance measurement is a period-aligned site ledger containing attributable revenue, AI cost, infrastructure cost, domains, labor, marketing, and experiment-level incremental outcomes. Continue only existing reconciliation, failure containment, measurement, and bounded security-evidence work; preserve unknowns and do not treat missing values as zero.

CFO attribution review: Amazon attribution is partial-aggregate despite complete tracking-ID mapping. The $4.92 commission is in an aggregate row that cannot be assigned to a site; named site rows show $0 commission. SEO totals of 14,033 impressions, 141 clicks, 977 sessions, and 15 conversions are operating metrics, not revenue proof. AI cost must not be presented as investment return without site-level attributable revenue and experiment-level incremental outcomes. Continue scheduled measurement using only source-dated impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, site-attributed commission, and available AI cost.
